tree.heading: Basis for Payment.—
tree.text: When practicable, payments under section 4501 of this title shall be made on any of the following bases:

children.text: Performance measured by objective, quantifiable methods such as delivery of acceptable items, work measurement, or statistical process controls.
Accomplishment of events defined in the program management plan.

tree.heading: Payment Amount.—
tree.text: Payments made under section 4501 of this title may not exceed the unpaid contract price.
